methodology: One fresh SGB process per graph, -tf mode, one timed run; wall time includes process startup. Reference independently enumerates all 4-vertex subsets using an adjacency matrix. Square components are formed by shared-diagonal union-find. Corrected output is checked for all square metrics, density, alpha, and connectivity, including disconnected inputs. Explicit legacy-output mode permits missing historical fields and marks validation incomplete. Intended CFS allows a complete join factor, with square support kept literal; its mismatch is reported separately from legacy-reference agreement. C100 tests finite zero-support output for an empty square graph.
